plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Three office games in your IDE: Turkish Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms. Connect to your office's Arcade Machine LAN server for shared daily challenges and live leaderboards.
plugin.change-notes: Create drawing rooms with your own round count and per-player drawing duration. The larger canvas takes priority, with readable room scores and daily rankings. New Eraser and Undo buttons let you correct complete drawing gestures for everyone. The server offers 835 Turkish prompts with persistent rotation across rooms and restarts. Room settings and Undo require server 0.3.4. Letter hints and Play Again remain available.
